title: Active Directory ACL Abuse (GenericAll)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for VERTEX.LAB (Vertex Media Group, a media and marketing agency), no Windows VMs. The low-privilege foothold user d.laurent (a content editor) holds a dangerous GenericAll access-control entry over the higher-value account b.whitfield (the archivist), which guards an archive share. Full control over a user object includes the right to reset its password without the old one: find the control edge, reset b.whitfield's password, authenticate as b.whitfield, and read the flag from a share d.laurent cannot open.
question: From the d.laurent foothold, abuse the GenericAll ACE over b.whitfield to reset its password, then authenticate as b.whitfield and read the flag from the //dc/archive share.
